item.text:
**Public draft**

A small update in this build series. I committed a reusable template.

The template is now part of the project’s history. There’s a version to come back to, and if it changes, there’s a starting point to compare it against.

**Private review note:** The commit receipt confirms the template was committed. The draft leaves the owner’s motivation, intended users, and any time savings open.
